हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: “Pyaar Ka Qatal” is a poignant tale of love, betrayal, and redemption. Ajay, a devoted but struggling man, gives everything for his wife Mouni and daughter, only to be humiliated and betrayed when Mouni chooses wealth and status over him. Heartbroken yet resilient, Ajay rebuilds himself into a successful entrepreneur. When he returns, the story unfolds a powerful journey of regret, truth, and the real meaning of love. Watch now!
